<div id="leap-filter-chip" class="leap-filter-chip" hidden>
  Filtered by: <strong><span id="leap-filter-name"></span></strong>
  <a href="#" id="leap-filter-clear">clear &times;</a>

::: {#all-articles}
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function applyFilter() {
    var m = location.hash.match(/category=([^&]+)/);
    var cat = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : null;
    document.querySelectorAll(".leap-grid .leap-card").forEach(function (card) {
      var cats = (card.dataset.categories || "").split("|");
      card.style.display = (!cat || cats.indexOf(cat) !== -1) ? "" : "none";
    });
    var chip = document.getElementById("leap-filter-chip");
    if (cat) {
      chip.hidden = false;
      document.getElementById("leap-filter-name").textContent = cat;
    } else {
      chip.hidden = true;
    }
  }
  document.getElementById("leap-filter-clear").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname);
    applyFilter();
  });
  window.addEventListener("hashchange", applyFilter);
  applyFilter();
})();
</script>
```
